lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions across Chad using the IPC framework. Geographic data were compiled into spatial datasets with IPC phase classifications, collection dates, and scenario projections for near-term food security outlook.
